messages:
fiona: Planning a JSONB index apply + small transform on metadata.events tonight 02:15 UTC. This is per-shard (shards 500-1499), concurrent index + small backfill. Requesting deploybot pin to schema-v3.6.0 for the window and canary only in us-east-2. Estimate: ~90m. Any concerns?
noah: Ack. Details on index and transform?
fiona: We'll add a GIN index on metadata->'tags' and run a compacting transform that normalizes tag keys. Steps: 1) ALTER TABLE .. ADD COLUMN tags_norm JSONB; 2) run chunked update to populate tags_norm from tags (normalize keys); 3) CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY ON (tags_norm); 4) swap to use tags_norm in queries.
sylvie: Lock expectations?
fiona: Minimal. ADD COLUMN is fast (nullable). Concurrent CREATE INDEX shouldn't block reads. Final cutover to use tags_norm will be app-level flag flip (no table rename). We will however run small exclusive locks when swapping defaults (~1-2s).
noah: Abort criteria suggestion: sustained p99 DB latency >300ms for 7m OR job error rate >1% OR replica_lag>75s. Also abort if queue backlog >400 for >10m.
fiona: Agree. Also add disk temp >88% as abort.
sylvie: Fallback if deploybot can't pin: gate behind feature flag 'events_tags_norm' false and stop runs. @noah can you manual-unpin?
noah: Yep I'll manual-unpin and flip flag. On pager.
deploybot: Pin accepted. schema-v3.6.0 pinned for release-group 'events-tags-normalize' at 3301234567. Canary set to us-east-2. Will emit progress updates every 12m and alert on configured thresholds.
opsbot: Drafted release note at release_notes/3301234567.md: "Add normalized tags (tags_norm) to metadata.events and build GIN index concurrently. Partitioned update; brief config flip when enabling normalized tags. Abort criteria and runbook in thread"
fiona: Runbook snippets:
```bash
# start shard backfill (example)
./run_transform --table=metadata.events --shard=500 --dst-col=tags_norm --chunk-size=10000 --concurrency=1 --run-id=3301234567
# emergency stop: mark controller
psql -c "UPDATE migration_control SET state='abort' WHERE run_id='3301234567'" 
# flip feature flag
psql -c "UPDATE feature_flags SET enabled=false WHERE name='events_tags_norm'" 
# unpin
deployctl pin --release-group events-tags-normalize --unpin
```
sylvie: Add smoke: after each shard backfill run `./scripts/smoke_events_tags.sh <shard>` for 10m. Fail if >2 errors. Post results here.
noah: I'll be watching p99, replica lag and queue backlog. DM me if thresholds hit and I'll unpin.
fiona: We'll kick shard-500 canary at 02:25 UTC (+10m) to allow pin reconciliation. If canary passes 15m health checks, proceed sequentially.
deploybot: Canary run started for shard-500. Posting status & metrics to this thread.
pager: Monitoring hooks added for p99, replica_lag, job_backlog, disk_temp. Will page on configured thresholds.
fiona: Thanks all — will post 12m progress notes and a final green before proceeding to next shard.
